title: Ischial spine
summary: The ischial spine is part of the posterior border of the body of the ischium bone of the pelvis.
It is a thin and pointed triangular eminence, more or less elongated in different subjects.

sections.heading: Structure
paragraphs: The pudendal nerve travels close to the ischial spine.

sections.heading: Clinical significance
paragraphs: The ischial spine can serve as a landmark in pudendal anesthesia, as the pudendal nerve lies close to the ischial spine.
